subject: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightline.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap

Hi Samantha,

Great to connect earlier on the call — excited about Brightline's use case for session-based triage. We can definitely demo the Redwood inference runtime and how the Dedicated offering could lower per-token cost for your throughput.

I know you're targeting an East Coast pilot and prefer a 9:00am ET slot next Tuesday (Apr 6). That translates to 14:00 UTC / 16:00 CEST for our EU engineering folks. Our EU team usually does late afternoons but Apr 6 is during a short staffing window because of a planned maintenance and a CEST → BST DST edge case coming up that week.

Would you be open to moving to one of these options so we can ensure the right engineers join:
- 7:30am ET / 12:30 UTC (our EU team would join right after lunch)
- 8:00am ET / 13:00 UTC (we can rotate Grace to an earlier shift)
- If neither works, we can run a split session: product-led walkthrough at 9:00am ET with me, then technical deep-dive (recorded) with engineering afterward and a live Q&A the next day.

I've attached a one-page agenda and a quick timezone matrix that shows team availability across EU/US/APAC.

Proposed next step: pick the option that suits you and I'll coordinate a short shift swap with Grace or Vivek to get engineering coverage.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: agenda_v1.pdf, timezone_matrix.xlsx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap

Hi Jordan — thanks for the quick follow-up and the materials.

7:30am ET is a bit too early for our execs (they prefer 9am–10am), but 8:00am ET could work for our engineering lead, if you can confirm an engineer from Redwood is on the call for the architecture portion. The split session approach is also acceptable if we can do the technical deep-dive the next day at a similar hour.

Can you confirm whether Grace or Vivek can do 8:00am ET on Apr 6? If not, let's plan to do the high-level demo at 9:00am ET and schedule the deep-dive for Apr 7 at 9:00am ET.

—Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships, Brightline Health
samantha.lee@brightline.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 16:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap

Jordan / Vivek — I can flex to cover the 8:00am ET slot on Apr 6 (that'll be 13:00 UTC / 15:00 CEST) if we keep the deep-dive to 45 minutes and focus on model routing, KV cache behaviour, and dedupe/caching recommendations. I'm swapping with Marta for that day — she'll cover my afternoon pager window.

Quick note on DST: our infra maintenance window is Apr 6 18:00–20:00 CEST, so as long as the call ends by 16:00 CEST we're fine. Also, if Brightline is later in the month we cross the DST boundary in the US (second Sunday in April) and times can shift — I attached an updated timezone matrix with those deltas.

Grace
Grace O'Connor | Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightline.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap

Thanks Grace — really appreciate the swap. Sam — Grace can do 8:00am ET on Apr 6 and cover the architecture portion. Vivek will join to talk about Dedicated capacity and SLOs. Aisha from CS will take the pilot success planning segment.

Final proposal:
- Apr 6, 2027 | 08:00–09:00 ET (13:00–14:00 UTC) — Full demo with engineering and CS
- Apr 7, 2027 | 09:00–09:30 ET (13:00–13:30 UTC) — Optional technical deep-dive / Q&A (if needed)

I'll send the calendar invite once you confirm. Also flagging the maintenance window Grace mentioned — we should finish by 16:00 CEST on Apr 6.

Jordan
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 02:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordinating an early-morning demo for East Coast prospect — propose shift swap

Jordan — this looks good, confirmed for Apr 6 at 8:00am ET.

A couple of small asks before the call:
- Can you send a 1-slide diagram (PDF) showing how Redwood routes requests between Hosted / Dedicated and the fallback logic?
- Any pre-demo logs or an SLO summary for Dedicated throughput at our expected 500 concurrent sessions would be helpful.

I'll accept the invite when it arrives. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sam
